channel.title: Latest alerts from South Africa Weather Service
channel.description: Welcome to the South African Weather Service RSS Feed for Weather Warning Alerts

item.title: Damaging Winds
item.description: Localised damage to settlements (formal and informal) Localised loss of agricultural production Some transport routes and travel services affected by wind, falling trees or dust storms

item.title: Damaging Winds
item.description: Localised damage to settlements (formal and informal) Localised problems for high-sided vehicles on prone routes e.g. due to cross winds on exposed high level roads/bridges Some transport routes and travel services affected by wind, dust storms Risk of localised runaway fires

item.title: Damaging Waves
item.description: -Localised disruption of small harbours and/or ports for a short period of time. -Difficulty in navigation. -Small vessels at risk of taking on water and capsizing in a locality. -Localised disruptions to beachfront activities.
